status.name: Go for Launch
status.description: Awaiting regulatory approval. Current target is NET September 28, 2026.

mission.name: Starlink Group 31-1
mission.description: The first orbital flight of the Starship system and its first operational Starlink deployment. Objectives: nominal ascent, boostback and offshore booster landing burn in the Gulf; orbital insertion; deployment of 26 Starlink V3 satellites; an ~8 hour coast; deorbit burn; and a controlled entry and splashdown in the Pacific. Also the first re-flight of thermal protection tiles, using two tiles previously flown on Ship 40.
